phone.changelog: v3.9.21: new streaming sources (vidsrc.io/fyi + superembed) for instant playback.

tv.changelog: v3.17.25: MovieBox-style instant streaming + smart failover. New sources vidsrc.io/fyi (built-in multi-server failover) + superembed (10+ servers). Server health prober skips dead servers before playback. Try-everything failover matrix (server→native→engine-toggle→dead). Per-server failure reasons. Graceful buffering messages. Exit-confirm dialog. Media keys + double-tap seek. Backdrop-blur removed.
